answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 2553 Country: Pakistan Title: If the difference arises between husband & wife then Who has the right to decide the names of children in Islam? Whether father or mother of the child? Question: If the difference arises between husband & wife then Who has the right to decide the names of children in Islam? Whether father or mother of the child? Answer ID: 2553 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1170/1163=J) A child belongs to father, therefore father is held responsible to nourish and nurture a child. Thus, father will have right to name his child. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
